metadata.body:
**The same R480 word as #503, priced at nine stages instead of eleven.** The word does not change. It is #493's R489
with its nine totals on dead registers (#503). Pricing it in the nine-stage whole-residual hosted pipeline gives:

| | stages | bit c |
|---|---|---|
| #493 (R489) | 11 (m = 78, 8 pooled replicas) | 0.001565442026981656908596 |
| #503 (R480) | 11 | 0.001574753352953808650916 |
| **this PR (R480)** | **9 (m = 64, 32 replicas)** | **`396861776523137034277/250000000000000000000000` = 0.001587447106092548137108** (+1.4057% over #493, +0.806% over #503) |

κ does not change, because the side that binds is the complex side. With #484's complex b (draft; Lemmas A and G) κ =
`662515748707749/500000000000000000` = 0.001325031497415498. With #471's it is 0.001303530097714685, and with #458's
0.001295523322678044. The bit gain is headroom.

**Why nine stages win here.** On the eleven-stage schedule the even-stage rank-7 idle children cannot host any width-8
residual, so they are paid in full. With only 480 helpers, nine stages host every residual whole: 138,240 = 9 × 32 ×
480, with 0 banks and maximum child 8. The smaller window m = 64 then prices lower. R489 at nine stages through the
same chain is 0.001576648413160438658485 (+0.716% over #493). On R715/R740, eleven stages were best.

## What is in `research/e8-r480-nine-stage/`
- `verify.py`. Parent: #503's verifier (`--light`, or full with #493's `verify.sh`). Then:
  - nine-stage formal columns: `columns_k`, KPAIRS = 4; 1,440 columns; 18/18 controls; payload 102 bits < 104;
  - nine-stage template: 288 invocations, F2 column replay;
  - parent audit: 17 mutations rejected;
  - #442 hosting, rediscovered exactly: all residuals whole, 0 banks;
  - independent hosted audit;
  - nine-stage bit invoice, both moment engines, and #493's outer loop: 47 strict inequalities and controls with
    #484, #471 and #458.
- `vendor/`: the nine-stage pipeline, byte-identical to PR #463 at `cdf0c1c` (git blob ids in `SOURCE.json`,
  recomputed). It is not on main; it is in open PRs #463 and #450. The lineage is #443, #444, #442 and #386.
- `code/assemble9.py`: #463's nine-stage invoice verbatim, plus #493's per-supplier loop verbatim.
  `code/adapt.py`: two listed edits to `audit_parent_k.py`.

- `code/findings/`: the checks for findings (a) and (b) below (`flowlp2.py`, `levels.py`, `piv0.py`), run by `verify.py`.

## Findings on the R489 family (knowledge)
Checked by `verify.py`:
- **(a) An LP floor of 480 for R480's skeleton.** The model is a min-flow LP on the frame lattice of one 4-frame. Its
  dual is a max-weight antichain. Node bounds come from the junk-dimension lemma: a cross cell needs ≥ 3 registers
  and a matching cell ≥ 4. The optimum is 16 helpers per 4-frame, so 480 (8 without the junk bounds). It assumes 3
  branches per source, 2 transverse quads per cell, and matching-cell sources that feed the block frame. R480
  attains every node bound. Each of its 480 helpers stands at exactly one cell and one D6 frame, so levels 2 and 6
  are tight. `verify.py` checks the LP optimum given these node bounds, and the tight levels on R480's own data. The junk-dimension lemma and the flow model itself (that every word of the family is such a flow) are argued here, not machine-checked.
- **(b) Kernel pivots on R480 and R489 are exactly 0** for coordinate and root-line entrances: all 120 line classes
  have nullity 0. All residuals stay width 8.

Exploration outside the package, not run by `verify.py`:
- **(c)** The helper ledger is at its floors: 240 carriers at the 4-design bound, and 240 further registers at the
  per-cell junk count, with every shared symbol at its Dilworth width. The copy-removal methods built on the
  #370-lattice words (read-then-climb, XOR fusion, Bcw inlining) have nothing to act on.
- **(d)** Idle fusion has no legal glue:
  - an X→Y bridge add mixes frames at rank 1 in #445's geometry (X wires contain the line q, Y wires do not);
  - with X→X/Y→Y shears only, a Gröbner test finds no glue at K = 2..5.

  Checks that compare only pair levels miss the X/Y frame difference. #493's own audit hard-codes X→X/Y→Y, so it is
  safe.

## Scope and review points (also in the README)
- The emitter is the per-replica nine-stage one (#444/#442 lineage, 32 replicas in groups of 8), not #472's pooled
  eleven-stage emitter. Its finite prefix is #443's per-stage product bound (193 bits), not #472's chronological
  bound. The prefix enters only the cutoffs.
- One audit adaptation. The template control "omit a residual route factor" needs an isometry that has a route
  factor. R480's helpers all enter at frame zero, so no isometry has one, and the selector raised StopIteration. The
  control is vacuous then and is skipped exactly in that case. The other 17 controls run.
- Mutable sources at nine stages. #493 grounds source-register writes below the full frame in #472's PROOF ("Shared
  physical labels"). The nine-stage address map is #443/#444's, whose proof does not discuss source destinations.
  What carries over:
  - #425's four word-level hypotheses, checked on R480 by #493's `interface.py` in the parent run;
  - the same local invocation and #386 frame operators;
  - the exact F2 replay of every template column, including the source ports' data families.

  The realisation sentence for #443's address map is stated, not re-proved. Please treat it as a listed conditional
  interface, as #493 does.
- Everything else is inherited from #493 and #503 unchanged. Complex savings are cited. No unconditional theorem is
  claimed.

## Credits
eumemic (#493), #503 (R480). Nine-stage pipeline: chafreaky (#443, #444, with OpenAI Codex), DaysSky (#442, #381),
Zhihao Chen (#386), DreamingOfClouds (#315; the #450/#463 pipeline adaptations), Dylan Crow (#370).

Prepared by DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), via Claude Code.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Change and mathematical scope
One new theorem, `CurrentMain.PR516CompleteBankEndpoint.full_state_endpoint`, connects the full physical helper/rest endpoint from #516 to the sequential completed-bank interface in #513. It directly reuses `LemmaA.family_endpoint`, `LemmaA.endpoint_indep`, #509's event semantics and Mathlib's `Equiv.funSplitAt`; it does not reprove their inductions.

Author-checked conditional source context:
- main/base: `12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b`
- κ = `90446448750933/125000000000000000 = 0.000723571590007464`
- This is the unchanged selected construction context, not a new exponent saving derived by this adapter.

## Coverage
- Finite: no new selected finite witness, census, matrix computation or numerical instance checker is claimed.
- Conditional interface: for arbitrary initial helper and rest values, the completed word gives the specified helper operator and rest output independent of the initial helper. Full unit row and zero off-diagonal helper column are separate hypotheses. The reference zero in the rest definition imposes no clean-state assumption.
- Full theorem: actual physical execution, injective owners, exact recipes, well-labelled events, full rows/columns including the work register, common-chart partial swap, all-60-replica partition/order, boundaries and physical costs remain explicit. No full multiplication/runtime theorem is proved.

This raises the conditional saving from [#531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531)'s `0.001517760977820331` to **κ = 0.001524207950793244**, exactly `381051987698311/250000000000000000`: a **0.42477% improvement in exponent saving**. The complex supplier still binds. This is a finite conditional witness under the retained all-size and analytic interfaces.

The construction retains #531's direct-delivery 504-helper architecture and 72 compatible line gauges. A new exact shared-donor selection gives **92 pivots instead of 80**. A new whole-owner allocation pays for all changed residual widths. It has 36,288 helper roles, 728 distinct active families per complete invocation, 7,536 remainder children, and no helper banks. Live and physical stock remain 7,168 and 7,682; the global rank deficit remains 2,560.

| Quantity | #531 | This increment |
|---|---:|---:|
| Kernel pivots | 80 | 92 |
| Width-eight / width-nine helpers | 152 / 352 | 164 / 340 |
| Local paid rank mass | 6,240 | 6,228 |
| Certified complex saving | 0.001520068077832496458155 | 0.001526534707131015364923 |
| Conditional κ | 0.001517760977820331 | 0.001524207950793244 |

The final global profile is `{1:146592,2:55584,3:12464,4:28224,5:7616,6:4032,7:944,48:912}`. Both exact moment engines accept the stated complex endpoint and reject the next 10^-24 grid point. Six bootstrap levels and all 47 strict outer inequalities give the displayed κ. The emitted prefix is 225 bits within the retained 512-bit charge.

## Reproduction and proof boundary

```sh
python -B research/direct504-kernel92/verify.py /tmp/direct504-kernel92-check
```

Standard library only, offline, with assertions enabled and a fresh output directory. The fixed verifier runs no optimizer. It rebuilds the raw factory and all rational donor relations, replays both 728-column local orientations, rejects every one of 92 omitted kernel corrections, checks the fourteen source-frontier bases, freshly lowers **all 2,924 local phase edges and 224 endpoint adapters**, verifies the seven residual wrappers, reconstructs actual physical owners and spectators, recounts the finite invoice, and runs both exact moment engines and the outer assembly.

The unchanged 112-port data controller/data-phase certificate and #493 bit operator remain pinned dependencies. The bit histogram is repriced in both exact engines; its physical operator is not cold-rebuilt here. No cached local phase is accepted in place of fresh lowering. Thirteen local mutations, five wrapper mutations, seven owner/controller mutations and four outer mutations are rejected. Optimized Python, a missing owner map and modified source reject before output creation.

`proof/CONSTRUCTION.md`, `EXPECTED.json`, `SOURCES.json` and `MANIFEST.json` contain the argument, exact result and file bindings. The entire attributed #531 package is preserved under `vendor/pr531`. Final frozen-source reconstruction passed on Linux/Python 3.11 and macOS/Python 3.14, with identical canonical-word, emitted-program and local-phase hashes. Receipts are in `research/direct504-kernel92-validation/`. A Python 3.11 gzip-header mismatch was reproduced as a single metadata-byte difference and fixed by pinning OS byte 255; no mathematical check was weakened. Dedicated CI runs Python 3.11 and 3.14. Remote CI is pending at submission.

## Sources and attribution

- **#531**, icekylinx, with GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI Codex assistance: same-partition direct delivery, 504-helper raw factory, gauge baseline, frame coalescing, and supplier/owner/invoice checkers. Pinned head `e07a8a3f9f79c22113398a0c5dbbc7601f489b3e`; its package is byte-identical to the initially checked `c609855ff92acc8cae3aa0808a4ecb624165f548`.
- **#523**, icekylinx: retained 112-port controller and restriction ancestry. **#514**, Dugongue, and **#507**, eumemic: packet and partial-own ancestry. **#505**, Dugongue: asynchronous scheduling lineage.
- **#417/#433/#435/#434/#440/#484** and the preserved source notices: shared-donor kernels and compatible entrance gauges, including DreamingOfClouds's implementation with Claude Opus 5.5 assistance. **#493**, eumemic: unchanged bit supplier.
- **#529**: independent omitted-correction checker, adapted to the actual port count, and its attributed #523 full-phase driver. Its rank-sector construction is not treated as an additive gain.
- **#425/#433/#370/#361/#315** and credited predecessors: geometry, phase compilation, exact moments and analytic framework.

The new frozen selection, whole-owner allocation and reconstruction package were prepared for chafreaky with **OpenAI Codex** assistance. All inherited notices and licenses are retained. No unrestricted optimality, new Lean certification, κ = 1 or unconditional multiplication theorem is claimed.

metadata.body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001526158885117467** (exact `1526158885117467/1000000000000000000`), **+0.55331% over #531** (0.001517760977820331) and +3.96% over #532.

This builds directly on @icekylinx's #531 (the branch contains the #531 commit plus this package). Scalar operations, helpers, widths, entrances, owner map, controller and every checker are #531's; the only change is a better assignment of operation frames.

Prepared by **rohanarun** with Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic). Apache-2.0. This is a derivative of
[#531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531) by **icekylinx**
(its direct-delivery 504-helper word, owner map, controller and every checker are reused unchanged).
The only new mathematical object is a different assignment of operation frames.

## Result

| Quantity | #531 | This package |
|---|---:|---:|
| Conditional κ | 0.001517760977820331 | **0.001526158885117467** |
| Complex lower rate b | 0.001520068077832496458155 | **0.001528491606163040267702** |
| Cited #493 bit rate c | 0.001565442026981656908596 | same |
| Local profile | {1:2028,2:752,3:156,4:392,5:56,6:56,7:8} | **{1:2220,2:368,3:460,4:168,5:168,6:56,7:8}** |
| Helpers / widths / entrance rank | 504 / {8:152,9:352} / 152 | same |
| Owner map, live/physical, deficit | 36,288 roles, 7168/7682, 2560 | same |

κ is **+0.55331%** over #531 and **+3.96329%** over #532. The complex supplier still binds.

## What changed

#531 ran a single-node greedy pass (248 promotions in delivery body B, each to the meet of its successors, accepted on the linear
entropy fee). We instead search the whole lattice of **monotone frame lifts** of the constructor word:

* every A/B operation frame G must contain the frame the #531 constructor assigned to it (`F ⊆ G`);
* every register chain (start frame, A, centre/target barriers, B, final frame) must stay monotone;
* scalar operations, cut, centres and centre frames, helper start frames, target levels and final frames are fixed.

Any such assignment is reachable by #531's own coalescing lemma: lift nodes from last to first; each step has predecessors inside the
constructor frame and successors already at their final frames. A seeded local search (`code/frame_chain_search.py`, moves = one-vector
raises with upward closure and codimension-one lowers with downward closure, bounded below by constructor frames) minimises
Σ_r H_r · r((73/r)^b − 1), the moment-excess fee. A 40-sandbox run (25 min per seed, temperatures 0 to 0.004) converged to the same fee in 23 of 40 seeds; the selected word lifts 725 frames (versus 248 in #531). Rank mass is unchanged
(6240), so helper widths, the owner map and all 7,968 idle remainders are identical; only the local histogram changes. Spreading rank
mass across children of ranks 3 to 5 moves the moment root up.

## Verification (all #531 checkers, fresh on the new word)

```
python -B verify_fast.py --work /absolute/new/output/dir
```

New stages: rebuild the #531 constructor word from the frozen selection (no search), then `code/check_frame_lifts.py`
proves every changed frame is a lift of its constructor frame and every chain is monotone. Then the unchanged #531 stages run:
exact arbitrary-dirt forward and inverse-transpose scalar replay on all 728 columns with native frame chains, binding to the 112-port
controller, emission and independent audit of the actual whole-owner placement, fresh prefix and finite invoice (prefix 225 < 512 bits),
and two exact moment engines with all 47 strict outer inequalities.

metadata.body:
This extends the merged [#531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531) supplier with post-center compensation and rank-four response kernels. It is one new commit based on main at `f19cb621be2caf3a7291a37c343c1c55afe935e0`.

Under the retained all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-basis realization, normalized Lemma A, whole-call hosting, restored-work, precision/tape and analytic-transfer interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{1584931111785787}{10^{18}}
=0.001584931111785787.
$$

The saving is **4.42561% above #531** and **3.98392% above [#533](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/533)**. These percentages compare exponent savings, not practical runtime.

## Construction

The 112 ordinary-M helpers remain untouched through the source prefix and center cut. Their initial dirt can therefore be compensated at the beginning of delivery. In each of fourteen disjoint groups, four response columns span the other four, and every helper's first native frame contains a common rank-four frame.

Perform the gauge compensations first, then inject each pivot into its donors at that rank-four frame. A donor can now serve both its own gauge and the larger kernel: its compensation has already read its initial dirt before the new pivot contribution arrives. Exact response relations, target chains, nested frames and the full inverse cleanup are checked on the emitted word.

The entrance inventory is 40 rank-one kernel pivots, 112 rank-one gauges and 56 rank-four pivots. The 504 residual widths are consequently 56 of width five, 152 of width eight and 296 of width nine. A fresh whole-owner assignment and finite invoice produce the global profile.

| Quantity | #531 | This increment |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Ports / helpers | 112 / 504 | 112 / 504 |
| Total entrance rank | 152 | 376 |
| Local rank mass | 6,240 | 6,016 |
| Live / physical families | 7,168 / 7,682 | 7,168 / 7,682 |
| Global rank deficit | 2,560 | 2,560 |
| Certified complex saving | 0.001520068077832496458155 | 0.001589991533606044174031 |

The complex supplier now exceeds the previous bit endpoint. The final composition therefore adopts the published [#510](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/510) R480 nine-stage bit supplier at `0.001587447106092548137108`; **the bit side binds**. This bit improvement is adopted and credited, not claimed as new work here. The unchanged #493 bit supplier gives the separate control κ `0.001562995248531632`.

Both component moments are repriced by two rational engines. Six bootstrap levels and all 47 strict outer inequalities certify the displayed global κ; adjacent-grid and invalid-parameter controls are rejected.

## Contribution sources and prior PRs

| Source | Contributor | Retained contribution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [#531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531), `e07a8a3f9f79c22113398a0c5dbbc7601f489b3e` | icekylinx | SAME504 scalar architecture, geometry, frame coalescing, phase compiler and owner/controller baseline. |
| [#510](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/510), `64edee18af02aab0c1696b677a0287dd0146381b` | DreamingOfClouds, with disclosed Claude assistance | Adopted R480 nine-stage bit supplier and its conditional interfaces. |
| [#484](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/484) and its credited predecessors | DreamingOfClouds and upstream contributors | Response-kernel, gauge and normalized-wrapper primitives. |
| #493, #503, #443/#444/#472, #442, #386 and #425 | Credited upstream contributors | Mutable-source bit word, R480 change, replication and whole-call hosting, geometry and common-label realization. |
| #514/#507, #361/#315 and retained framework | Credited upstream contributors | Scalar construction ancestry, rational moments and outer/analytic interfaces. |

My [#523](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/523) supplied the 112-port restriction; [#433](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/433) supplied split centers and source-basis reuse. Earlier contributions in #10, #18, #24, #32, #36, #104, #115, #130 and #144 concern batched boundaries, partial swaps, gauges, certified assembly and frame/cover constructions. These are provenance, not additive numerical gains. The earlier packages retain Dugongue's asynchronous scheduling and other source-specific credits.

The new ordered gauge/kernel composition, rank-four construction, physical integration and carryover exposition are contributed by **icekylinx**, with **GPT-6 Astra** assistance. Local review and packaging used **OpenAI Codex**. `NOTICE.md`, `SOURCES.json` and the separate original #531/#510 notices preserve the contribution boundaries.

## Proof and validation

The incremental package is `research/post-center-rank4-global/`; it reuses the baseline already present in main.

- `proof/POST-GAUGE-RANK4-PROOF.md`: ordered compensation, exact relations, frames and cleanup.
- `proof/GLOBAL-HOSTING-PROOF.md`: actual owners, paid profile and finite accounting.
- `proof/PR510-MUTABLE-SOURCE-CARRYOVER.md`: role-independent common-label argument and explicit bit dependency scope.
- `evidence/audit/EXACT-ASSEMBLY.json`: both component moments and all strict assembly margins.
- `BASELINE-PINS.json`, `MANIFEST.json`, `LOCAL-VALIDATION.json`: inherited inputs, submitted-file bindings and incremental validation.

```sh
python -B research/post-center-rank4-global/replay_delta.py \
  --baseline research/direct-delivery504-global \
  --work /tmp/rank4-check
```

Local validation also used `--rebuild-local --delta-phases` with Python 3.14.8 and NumPy 2.3.5. The full changed-word construction, scalar/frame replay, physical owner audit, fresh invoice and exact assembly passed. The newly introduced intermediate phase cache was checked against #531 (194 changed edges), followed by the final 126-edge delta. Independent local replay covered both orientations on all 728 columns; all 21 residual wrappers passed, including global phases, with 11 local and five wrapper mutation controls rejected.

The manifest was generated from staged Git files, excluding all logs. A clean archive of those staged files passed the same incremental reconstruction in 14.85 seconds. Every baseline pin also resolved and matched inside that archive. The PR510 data copy differs from its pinned source only by an appended terminal LF; both byte hashes and the unchanged JSON data are documented in `SOURCES.json`.

Package manifest SHA256: `23143f650947a2b95b443a7ea5ded79d1d5644783b7f8a54967ba137b8b801f8`.

Global template content SHA256: `b9f4b60e56e5153c1fc89370e9ceb09f24b23e1c8ff56f2b47ef9d867aa04f2c`.

Dedicated Python 3.11/3.14 CI covers reconstruction, changed phases and local wrappers. Remote results are pending. No predecessor cold replay, full bit-operator rebuild or PDF generation was performed.

This remains a finite conditional witness. The cited #510 physical bit operator and the inherited all-size/analytic contracts remain dependencies; the package does not claim an unconditional multiplication theorem, new Lean formalization or unrestricted optimality.

metadata.body:
## Result

Conditional **kappa = 0.001538356846647141**, exactly `1538356846647141/1000000000000000000`: **+1.356990%** over pinned #531's `0.001517760977820331`.

The complex supplier binds at `b = 385181758657419704781/250000000000000000000000`. The unchanged cited #493 bit supplier remains `c = 391360506745414227149/250000000000000000000000`. The result is +4.794222% over our previous deliverable, but most of that comparison comes from incorporating #531; the new contribution beyond #531 is the stated +1.356990%. No separate gains are added together.

## Mechanism: optimize response dimension together with actual residual capacity

The public direct504 word warms helpers using line relations. We instead compute exact response kernels over the common first-frame intersection of each active support. Eight rank-four components and sixteen rank-one components give72 pivots and32 residual helpers of width5. The resulting full local profile is

```
{1:2048,2:732,3:176,4:360,5:56,6:56,7:8}
```

with504 helper roles and widths `32x5,112x8,360x9`. Local rank mass falls from6240 to6152, while total helper width also falls by88. That conservation law preserves the global deficit; it does not by itself establish an improvement.

The decisive new physical construction uses **2,304 exact fills `32 = 5+9+9+9`**. A timed integer pattern witness and explicit whole-owner matching realize every helper occurrence. The final histogram, including every positive idle remainder, is

```
{1:147456,2:52704,3:15258,4:25920,5:5311,6:4032,7:2816,23:1,48:998}
```

Its rank mass is520704 =73*7168-2560. Live stock7168, physical stock7682, ambient rank73 and deficit2560 stay at #531's values. The new map contains36,288 helper occurrences,16,128 pending bins and3,248 actual73-column charts;7,104 positive remainder children are paid. No helper alias, free storage, ignored spectator, recursive splitter or newly assumed oracle is used.

## Four proved construction theorems, applied at different levels

1. **Support-saturated response calculus.** Exact pivot relations lift to any admissible common entrance of their entire active support; disjoint closed supports compose. The exact signed resource signature is derived from affected frame-chain edges. In a fixed affine resource regime, concavity gives an endpoint comparison principle. This finds higher-dimensional entrances that a pivot-count-only objective misses.
2. **Integral residual-pattern calculus.** A finite time/pattern certificate plus matching decomposition realizes whole physical owners. The proof includes the actual timeline, injectivity, source-specific charts, spectator restoration and all remainders. For this certificate, an exact rational logarithm enclosure proves strict complete-moment dominance for every `0 < b <= 0.002`, not only one floating-point probe.
3. **Contextual observational rewriting.** If the exact suffix responses satisfy `H_t = lambda H_u`, a background addition can be retargeted with matching coefficient and regenerated inverse cleanup. The concrete gate `A[645]`, `31 += (1/2)*240`, becomes `245 -= 240` because `H_31 = -2 H_245 != 0`. Every frame chain is unchanged; this is a nonzero-response rewrite, not dead-store deletion. It saves four counted local scalar primitives but has no independent recursive-moment gain.
4. **Finite supplier-registry gluing.** The filtered and retargeted concrete words are selected in36 complete calls each. Their entire normalized endpoints, including paid helper residual operators, agree under the actual charts. Scalar dirty restoration is distinguished from physical residual action. A common pending-operator normal form proves legal contextual assembly and the exact mass ledger; every selected program/hash/frame/width is bound per call.

Full sufficient proofs and construction witnesses are in `proof/`. These are newly written arguments for this composition, not claims that contextual equivalence, concavity or matching decomposition are globally new mathematics. The first two produce the exponent gain; the latter two are exercised concrete program-calculus extensions. No new Lean certification or four independent numerical gains are claimed.

## Direct sources and credits

- **#531**, head `c609855ff92acc8cae3aa0808a4ecb624165f548`:504-helper direct delivery, ordered112-port factory,72 gauges, frame-coalescing mechanism, data controller, exact phases and global invoice. This is the direct comparison baseline and the main inherited construction.
- **#523**, head `a900f98be8ff2c09d3292b5112d4731dbd0c8438`:112-port restriction, data geometry, phase cache and retained finite allowance.
- **#514, #507 and #484**: Hamming/scalar factory, entrance gauges, shared-donor response-kernel construction, whole-owner and dirty-wrapper framework. **#522**: coordinate-total/rank-sector viewpoint and previous response-space exploration. **#520**: delivery and explicit allocation perspective.
- **#505, #508 and #518**: complete-invocation scheduling and composition ancestry. **#493**, head `c3a9a436b84fe44fdc223a5784d84736d1c2d3c7`: unchanged bit supplier, reused as a pinned dependency and repriced without redundant operator reconstruction.
- **#458, #433, #425 and #370**: normalized residual wrappers, scalar/frame transport and exact phase/compiler ancestry. **#361 and #315**: the two exact moments and outer assembly engines.
- **#528**, head `ba5e50abb80c6b854b127ccbe37d524e11c6db72`: complete-bank full-state interface informed the registry proof. Its physical realization hypotheses are retained, not silently discharged.
- **#526 and #530**: recent machine/counting compositional results read; no numerical saving imported. **#527 and #529**: recent comparable numerical constructions read and superseded by the #531 baseline; their gains are not stacked.
- Structural sources: Mathlib's `Real.concaveOn_rpow`; OpenAI's `MatchingCount.UnitFlow`, `PerfectMatching.Main`, `WLIdentification.FiniteRefinement` and `GroupRing.WordResponse`; and prior tensor-isomorphism dirty-workspace composition work. These motivated the abstractions rather than supplying an unproved imported algorithm. Module/source hashes and precise roles are recorded in `research-notes/`.

The public snapshot is frozen through #531. `SOURCES.json` and the retained ancestry pin relevant heads. No live refresh was performed during packaging.

## Reproduce and evidence

From `research/filtered-supplier-registry`, with Python3.11+ and NumPy:

```
python -B verify.py --work /absolute/path/to/a-new-output-directory
```

Offline, with no optimizer or search during verification. All **18 stages passed from a fresh CRLF copy**, including:

- deterministic rational source reconstruction and the exact observational rewrite;
- both728-column orientations for both variants, actual frame chains, phase-correct residual wrappers and13 local mutation controls per variant;
-2,934 directed phase edges per variant, including120 freshly lowered changes on the filtered source; unchanged edges are explicitly source-bound to the public cache;
- independent owner chronology, all charts,11 rejected physical/registry corruptions and the separate exact resource audit with5 controls;
- actual scalar/Horner and finite invoice:225 prefix bits required versus512 charged; row coefficient16467 versus20161 retained;
- two exact rational moments with adjacent-endpoint rejection, six bootstrap steps and all47 strict outer inequalities.

Template SHA-256:

```
f75929eadcdeb5f242706c409afd4e1e71efea2297961f15ec3365245f4de00b
```

The first packaging test caught elapsed time in phase-receipt fingerprints. Only that nonmathematical field is excluded from the stable registry fingerprint; mathematical source/recipe/compiler hashes and global-phase checks remain. Other artifacts retain raw hashes. Gzip level/header and LF serialization are pinned; the final outer-driver explicit level9 setting was byte-compared with the full replay. Mandatory manifest/expected-result checks and five transport corruption controls reject before output creation. Upload batches are reassembled byte-for-byte. Local execution was Windows Python3.11/NumPy2.4.6; no unexecuted platform test is claimed.

## Preserved alternatives and scope

The notes retain the failed55-call allocation, the smaller positive46-call cross-call transfer, the later dominating72-call saturation, two256-mask response hybrid screens, projective/suffix/protected-column rewrites and bounded neutral searches. Failure on a bounded family is not an impossibility theorem. The package does not claim a global optimum.

This remains conditional on the project's inherited all-size compilation, common-label/mutable-basis transport, normalized complete-wrapper realization, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer contracts. It is a checked improved finite construction under those interfaces, not an unconditional integer-multiplication theorem. Nothing was published automatically.
